purpose: Check that the Stage 2 fine-tuning pipeline (trainer revision 2) can learn a reachable voice before it is used for B1, B2, and H1.

setup.start: the Stage 2 base checkpoint (voice 2 = copy of M2)
setup.training_target: F2's own audio for the 50 enrollment sentences (base model, voice 0, noise seed 0), annotated with the same pipeline as the real target (train/stage2_annotate.py)
setup.training: B1 (voice rows only), lr 0.01, 300 steps, seed 0, trainer revision 2 (train/stage2_finetune.py)
setup.evaluation: VALIDATION, 20 sentences. Voice 2 is synthesized with noise seed 1. MCD reference: F2's audio of the same sentence with noise seed 0. Speaker-similarity reference: the centroid of the WavLM x-vectors of F2's 50 enrollment utterances (noise seed 0).

gap_closed.speaker_similarity: (sim(trained voice 2) - sim(start voice 2)) / (sim(F2, noise seed 1) - sim(start voice 2))
gap_closed.mcd: (MCD(start voice 2) - MCD(trained voice 2)) / (MCD(start voice 2) - MCD(F2, noise seed 1))

pass: gap closed >= 0.70 in speaker similarity AND >= 0.70 in MCD. If it fails, stop under rule (c).
